planned_methods_raw: ["1. Early discharge planning based on documented EDD. 2. Consistent use of Whiteboards to keep patients and families aware of the discharge plan, including date and time. 3. Utilization of our Flex Plan, including overlapping to enhance patient flow. 4. Facilitate weekend discharges when possible 5. Review TTIB each day to increase awareness and for learning in order to find opportunities to improve. 6. Continue to provide a weekly TTIB report for review at Wednesday's bed meetings 7. Monitor and review transfer times between units to improve patient flow. 8. NOW Rounding on units to bring awareness to frontline staff 9. Working on DASH initiative for delirium prevention. 10.Future bed mapping exercise being planned for 2026 to look at the distribution of beds. 11. Will work on proactive discharge practices (plans within 24-48 hours) with physicians and transfer accountability, and barriers to 1000am discharge times. 12. Regular sharing of data with front line, newsletter, and celebrations."]
